title: VanEck Launches All-in-One Wealth Builder ETF With Bitcoin Exposure
summary: Bitcoin Magazine VanEck Launches All-in-One Wealth Builder ETF With Bitcoin Exposure VanEck launched its Wealth Builder ETF (WBMO) on the NYSE, bundling stocks, bonds, gold and indirect bitcoin exposure into one fund for 0.26% a year. This post VanEck Launches All-in-One Wealth Builder ETF With Bitcoin Exposure first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
